title: Incident response
goal: Show an operational incident workflow across on-call, engineering, and communications teams.

rubric.must: Three visible grouped areas distinguish On-call, Engineering, and Communications work.
A severity decision visibly pages an incident commander for the high-severity branch.
An unrestored-service branch visibly escalates a specialist and loops back to mitigation.
A no-customer-impact path visibly closes after investigation without entering the major incident path.
The communications group visibly contains both a status update and a resolution update.
Resolved incidents visibly lead to a scheduled postmortem.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the flowchart exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows all requested workflow branches and team areas. Connections are traceable, labels are readable, and no material overlap or cropping is visible.

items.evidence: Three distinct grouped areas are labeled ON-CALL, ENGINEERING, and COMMUNICATIONS.
The “Severity 1 or 2?” decision’s Yes branch leads to “Page incident commander.”
“Service restored?” branches No to “Escalate specialist,” with a dashed loop returning to “Mitigate service.”
The No branch from “Customer impact?” leads to “Investigate and close,” which connects to “Resolve incident.”
The COMMUNICATIONS group contains both “Publish status update” and “Send resolution update.”
